name: resolve_human_entity
description: Resolve fuzzy human text such as a person name, vehicle description, plate, group, or friendly gate/garage name to exact IACS IDs before technical tool calls.

query.description: Natural language entity reference, for example Steph, the Tesla, PE70, or main garage.

entity_types.description: Optional entity types to search. Defaults to all.

name: query_presence
description: Return current presence state for everyone or a named person. This returns state only, not elapsed duration.

name: get_system_users
description: Return non-sensitive system account roster for access-control context.

name: query_device_states
description: Return current states for configured gates, doors, and garage doors.

target.description: Optional friendly device name, for example Top Gate, Back Door, or Main Garage Door.

name: get_maintenance_status
description: Return whether global Maintenance Mode is active, who enabled it, when it started, and how long it has been active.

name: get_active_malfunctions
description: Return active or FUBAR gate malfunctions, including attempt counts, next retry times, status, and optional timeline.

name: get_malfunction_history
description: Return historical gate malfunctions, optionally filtered by active, resolved, or fubar status.

name: trigger_manual_malfunction_override
description: Manually recheck, run a recovery attempt now, mark resolved, or mark FUBAR for a gate malfunction. State-changing actions require confirm=true.

name: enable_maintenance_mode
description: Enable global Maintenance Mode. This disables automated actions and requires confirm=true.

reason.description: Human-readable reason to audit and use in notifications.

confirm.description: Must be true before Maintenance Mode is enabled.

name: disable_maintenance_mode
description: Disable global Maintenance Mode and resume automated actions. Requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true before Maintenance Mode is disabled.

name: open_device
description: Open or close a configured gate or garage door. Opening gates and garage doors requires confirm=true; closing is supported for configured garage doors.

target.description: Friendly device name, for example Top Gate or Main Garage Door.

entity_id.description: Optional internal device identifier when already known.

confirm.description: Must be true before the device will be opened.

name: command_device
description: Open or close a configured gate or garage door. Use action=close for garage door close requests. This is a real-world side effect and requires confirm=true.

target.description: Friendly device name, for example Top Gate or Main Garage Door.

entity_id.description: Optional internal device identifier when already known.

confirm.description: Must be true before the device command will be executed.

name: open_gate
description: Open a configured gate. This is a real-world side effect and requires confirm=true.

target.description: Optional friendly gate name. If omitted, the only configured gate is used.

confirm.description: Must be true before the gate will be opened.

name: toggle_maintenance_mode
description: Enable or disable global Maintenance Mode. This is state-changing and requires confirm=true.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for enabling Maintenance Mode.

confirm.description: Must be true before Maintenance Mode changes.

name: query_visitor_passes
description: List Visitor Pass records and their linked arrival/departure telemetry. Use this for expected visitors and follow-ups such as what car a visitor arrived in.

search.description: Visitor name, plate, make, or colour text.

fuzzy_name.description: When true, include close visitor-name matches for duplicate checks.

name: get_visitor_pass
description: Get one Visitor Pass by ID or visitor name, including linked vehicle details and visit duration.

name: create_visitor_pass
description: Create a one-shot Visitor Pass for an expected unknown vehicle. For one-time passes, do not call until visitor_name and expected_time are known. For duration passes, valid_from and valid_until are required; visitor_phone is optional. Use local site time silently and default to a +/- 30 minute window when window_minutes is omitted. Do not resolve visitor_name as a Person record. Requires confirm=true.

visitor_phone.description: Optional visitor WhatsApp/mobile number. Use full international format when known.

number_plate.description: Optional visitor vehicle registration when the host already knows it.

expected_time.description: Expected local or ISO datetime for the visitor.

window_minutes.description: Minutes before and after expected_time. Defaults to 30.

valid_from.description: Start datetime for duration Visitor Passes.

valid_until.description: End datetime for duration Visitor Passes.

name: update_visitor_pass
description: Update a scheduled or active Visitor Pass. Requires confirm=true.

visitor_name.description: Pass lookup name or replacement visitor name.

new_visitor_name.description: Replacement visitor name when renaming a pass.

name: cancel_visitor_pass
description: Cancel a scheduled or active Visitor Pass. Requires confirm=true.

name: trigger_icloud_sync
description: Manually sync connected iCloud Calendars and generate Visitor Passes for events whose notes or description contain Open Gate. Requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true before calendar sync runs.

name: query_access_events
description: LPR/access log lookup for arrivals, exits, denials, and who came or went. Use this when the user semantically asks when or whether someone arrived, left, headed out, bolted, went, came in, got back, or changed site presence. This returns event timestamps and event lists, not elapsed durations. Resolve fuzzy people/vehicles first when needed.

person.description: Person name only when an exact person_id is not available.

person_id.description: Exact Person UUID from resolve_human_entity or actor context.

vehicle_id.description: Exact Vehicle UUID from resolve_human_entity or actor context.

direction.description: Use exit for departure meaning such as left, gone, headed out, bolted, or outta here; entry for arrival meaning such as arrived, came in, returned, or got back; denied for rejected access.

summarize_payload.description: Default true. Return compact schedule/gate payload summaries instead of raw payloads.

name: diagnose_access_event
description: Explain a specific or latest gate/LPR access event by joining the access event, telemetry trace spans, gate action outcome, notification workflow diagnostics, nearby LPR timing observations, and same-plate history.

access_event_id.description: Access event UUID when already known.

person_id.description: Exact person UUID when already known.

vehicle_id.description: Exact vehicle UUID when already known.

unknown_only.description: When true, resolve the latest event for an unknown/unmatched plate.

name: investigate_access_incident
description: Run a full Alfred access incident investigation. Use this for missing access events, nothing logged, no notification, gate/garage failures, schedule denials, and any case where diagnose_access_event finds no matching IACS event. It compares IACS records, IACS suppressed vehicle-session reads, telemetry, Home Assistant gate observations, maintenance mode, schedules, notifications, and durable UniFi Protect event/track history before recommending a fix.

expected_time.description: Expected local or ISO time, for example 07:38 or 2026-04-29T07:38:00.

confirm.description: Confirm the recommended internal remediation when one is available.

name: query_unifi_protect_events
description: Query durable UniFi Protect event history over a specific window and optionally parse smartDetectTrack LPR candidates for each event.

smart_detect_type.description: Optional smart detect type such as licensePlate or vehicle.

registration_number.description: Optional plate/VRN candidate to match against track data.

start.description: ISO datetime window start. Interpreted in site timezone if no timezone is supplied.

end.description: ISO datetime window end. Interpreted in site timezone if no timezone is supplied.

name: backfill_access_event_from_protect
description: Create a missing IACS access event from durable UniFi Protect LPR evidence, durable IACS suppressed-read evidence, or explicit admin-provided details. Requires Admin and confirm=true. Never opens gates, garage doors, runs automations, or sends normal arrival/departure notifications.

suppressed_read_captured_at.description: Captured time of the suppressed read to repair.

captured_at.description: Captured local or ISO time when explicit admin details are used.

name: test_unifi_alarm_webhook
description: Ask UniFi Protect to fire a safe Alarm Manager webhook test when the installed uiprotect package supports it. Requires confirm=true because it calls an external system.

trigger_id.description: UniFi Protect Alarm Manager trigger ID.

name: query_lpr_timing
description: Return recent raw LPR timing observations from webhooks and UniFi Protect, including captured-to-received delay where available.

source.description: Optional source filter, for example webhook or uiprotect_track.

include_possible_fields.description: Include candidate fields that looked like LPR payloads but did not normalize to a plate.

include_payload_path.description: Include payload path diagnostics. Defaults false to keep observations compact.

name: query_vehicle_detection_history
description: Count how many times a plate has appeared at the gate. Set latest_unknown=true to resolve the latest unknown/unmatched vehicle first.

latest_unknown.description: Resolve and count the latest unknown vehicle.

name: get_telemetry_trace
description: Fetch a compact telemetry trace and bounded span list by trace ID or access event ID.

summarize_payload.description: Default true. Summarize nested payloads instead of returning raw payloads.

name: query_leaderboard
description: Return the Top Charts leaderboard for known VIP plates and denied unknown Mystery Guest plates.

scope.description: Which Top Charts section to return.

enrich_unknowns.description: Whether to include live DVLA enrichment for unknown plates.

search.description: Optional person, vehicle, or plate text to filter leaderboard rows.

person.description: Optional known person name to filter VIP rows.

registration_number.description: Optional plate to filter known or unknown rows.

name: query_anomalies
description: Return active/open and resolved alert records, including resolution notes, snapshot metadata, linked access-event details, and stored vehicle visual evidence. Use status=all and suspected_delivery=true for supplier or delivery questions such as oil deliveries, Dove Fuels, or truck/lorry/tanker evidence in alert snapshots.

status.description: Alert status to inspect. active is accepted as an alias for open.

search.description: Optional text to search across alert message, registration, resolution note, context, and linked event payload.

suspected_delivery.description: Set true when looking for likely supplier/delivery visits, including oil deliveries.

example_inputs.search: oil delivery Dove Fuels truck tanker

name: query_alert_activity
description: Return alerts raised and alerts resolved in a period. Use this for alert-only questions such as what alerts were raised today, what alerts were resolved today, or raised/resolved alert activity. This inspects alert/anomaly records only and does not include gate maintenance or malfunction summaries.

status.description: Defaults to all for raised/resolved activity.

search.description: Optional alert text, plate, note, or context search.

name: analyze_alert_snapshot
description: Analyze a retained active or resolved alert snapshot with the active vision-capable provider. Use after query_anomalies returns an alert_id and snapshot when visual confirmation is needed, for example checking whether a snapshot shows a truck, lorry, tanker, or Dove Fuels branding.

prompt.description: What to inspect in the retained snapshot.

name: summarize_access_rhythm
description: Summarize arrivals, exits, denials, and anomalies for a recent period.

name: calculate_visit_duration
description: Calculate on-site visit duration by pairing an entry with a following exit. Use for elapsed on-site duration questions, including how long someone stayed, visited, or was here. This returns a duration, not just an arrival timestamp.

name: calculate_absence_duration
description: Calculate off-site absence duration by pairing an exit with the next entry. Use for elapsed off-site duration questions, including ongoing still-away absence and returned absence. This is the inverse of visit duration: exit-to-entry, not entry-to-exit. By default, report the latest matched absence; use mode=total only when the user asks for total time out.

name: trigger_anomaly_alert
description: Send a contextual anomaly alert notification. Requires confirm=true because this sends real notifications.

name: lookup_dvla_vehicle
description: Look up UK vehicle details from the DVLA Vehicle Enquiry Service by registration number.

registration_number.description: Vehicle registration number without spaces or punctuation.

name: analyze_camera_snapshot
description: Fetch a current UniFi Protect camera snapshot and ask the active vision-capable AI provider to analyze it.

prompt.description: What to inspect in the snapshot.

example_inputs.prompt: Is there a vehicle at the gate?

name: read_chat_attachment
description: Read text from a user-uploaded chat document, or analyze an uploaded image with the active vision-capable provider.

file_id.description: Chat attachment file ID returned by upload.

prompt.description: Question or extraction goal for the attachment.

name: export_presence_report_csv
description: Generate a CSV export of current presence and recent access events, then return a secure chat download link.

name: generate_contractor_invoice_pdf
description: Generate a simple PDF contractor visit invoice from calculated visit duration and return a secure chat download link.

name: get_camera_snapshot
description: Fetch a current UniFi Protect camera snapshot and return it as a secure chat image attachment.

name: query_notification_catalog
description: Return notification workflow building blocks: trigger events, variables, delivery integrations, endpoints, and mock preview context.

name: query_notification_workflows
description: List DB-backed notification workflows, optionally filtered by trigger, active status, or search text.

name: get_notification_workflow
description: Get one notification workflow by ID or name, including normalized conditions/actions and rendered preview.

rule_name.description: Notification workflow name or unique partial name.

name: create_notification_workflow
description: Create a DB-backed notification workflow. Requires confirm=true because future matching events may send real notifications.

Workflow action. type is mobile for Apprise, voice for Home Assistant TTS, in_app for dashboard alerts, discord for Discord channel alerts, or whatsapp for WhatsApp Admin messages.

target_ids.description: For Discord actions, use endpoint ids in the form discord:<channel_id>. For WhatsApp actions, use whatsapp:admin:<user_id>, whatsapp:*, or whatsapp:number:@Variable.

title_template.description: Title template supporting @ variables such as @FirstName.

message_template.description: Message template supporting @ variables such as @VehicleName.

gate_malfunction_stages.description: For the gate_malfunction trigger, optional stages this action should deliver. Empty means all stages.

name: update_notification_workflow
description: Edit an existing notification workflow. Requires confirm=true because future matching events may send changed notifications.

rule_name.description: Notification workflow name or unique partial name.

name: delete_notification_workflow
description: Delete a notification workflow by ID or name. Requires confirm=true.

rule_name.description: Notification workflow name or unique partial name.

name: preview_notification_workflow
description: Render a saved or unsaved notification workflow with mock or supplied context without sending anything.

rule_name.description: Notification workflow name or unique partial name.

Workflow action. type is mobile for Apprise, voice for Home Assistant TTS, in_app for dashboard alerts, discord for Discord channel alerts, or whatsapp for WhatsApp Admin messages.

message_template.description: Message template supporting @ variables such as @VehicleName.

gate_malfunction_stages.description: For the gate_malfunction trigger, optional stages this action should deliver. Empty means all stages.

context.description: Optional notification context payload/facts used for variable rendering.

name: test_notification_workflow
description: Verify a saved or unsaved workflow by sending its actions through configured providers. Requires confirm_send=true because this sends real test notifications.

rule_name.description: Notification workflow name or unique partial name.

gate_malfunction_stages.description: For the gate_malfunction trigger, optional stages this action should deliver. Empty means all stages.

name: query_automation_catalog
description: Return automation building blocks: trigger, condition, action, variable, notification-rule, and garage-door catalogs.

name: query_automations
description: List DB-backed automation rules, optionally filtered by trigger, active status, or search text.

name: get_automation
description: Get one automation rule by ID or name, including normalized triggers, conditions, actions, and optional dry-run preview.

automation_name.description: Automation rule name or unique partial name.

name: create_automation
description: Create a system automation rule. Requires confirm=true because saved active rules may later command gates, garage doors, maintenance mode, or notification states. Resolve people, vehicles, and notification rules first.

items.description: Automation trigger object. type is one of the automation catalog trigger keys; config holds trigger-specific filters or schedule settings.
Automation condition object. Supported types include person.on_site, person.off_site, vehicle.on_site, vehicle.off_site, maintenance_mode.enabled, and maintenance_mode.disabled.

Automation action object. Hardware, maintenance, notification, and integration actions run later when the saved rule fires. Integration actions use catalog types such as integration.icloud_calendar.sync with config {provider:'icloud_calendar', action:'sync_calendars'}.

reason_template.description: Optional audit reason template supporting @ variables.

name: edit_automation
description: Edit an existing automation rule. Requires confirm=true because future matching events may perform changed actions.

automation_name.description: Automation rule name or unique partial name.

items.description: Automation trigger object. type is one of the automation catalog trigger keys; config holds trigger-specific filters or schedule settings.
Automation condition object. Supported types include person.on_site, person.off_site, vehicle.on_site, vehicle.off_site, maintenance_mode.enabled, and maintenance_mode.disabled.

Automation action object. Hardware, maintenance, notification, and integration actions run later when the saved rule fires. Integration actions use catalog types such as integration.icloud_calendar.sync with config {provider:'icloud_calendar', action:'sync_calendars'}.

reason_template.description: Optional audit reason template supporting @ variables.

name: delete_automation
description: Delete an automation rule by ID or name. Requires confirm=true.

automation_name.description: Automation rule name or unique partial name.

name: enable_automation
description: Enable a saved automation rule. Requires confirm=true.

automation_name.description: Automation rule name or unique partial name.

name: disable_automation
description: Disable a saved automation rule. Requires confirm=true.

automation_name.description: Automation rule name or unique partial name.

name: override_schedule
description: Create a temporary one-off access allowance for a person. Default duration is 60 minutes and the action requires confirm=true.

person_id.description: Exact person UUID from actor context or resolve_human_entity.

time.description: Override start datetime or empty for now.

confirm.description: Must be true before the override is created.

name: query_schedules
description: List reusable access schedules, optionally filtered by name/description and with dependency counts.

name: get_schedule
description: Get one schedule by ID or name, including normalized time blocks and current People/Vehicle/Door dependencies.

name: create_schedule
description: Create a reusable weekly access schedule. Days are 0=Monday through 6=Sunday. Use time_blocks when confident, or time_description for natural language such as Wednesdays and Fridays 6am to 7pm. Do not call this until the user has supplied at least one allowed day/time block or time description.

time_description.description: Natural-language allowed time, for example Wednesdays and Fridays 6am to 7pm.

time_blocks.description: Monday-first schedule blocks keyed by day number 0-6, where 0 is Monday. Times must align to 30-minute increments.

confirm.description: Must be true before the schedule will be created.

name: update_schedule
description: Edit a schedule's name, description, or weekly time blocks. Unspecified fields are preserved.

description.description: Use an empty string to clear the description.

time_description.description: Natural-language replacement allowed time, for example weekdays 08:00-17:00.

time_blocks.description: Monday-first schedule blocks keyed by day number 0-6, where 0 is Monday. Times must align to 30-minute increments.

name: delete_schedule
description: Delete a schedule only when it has no People, Vehicle, Gate, or Garage Door dependencies. Requires confirm=true.

name: query_schedule_targets
description: List People, Vehicles, Gates, and Garage Doors with their current schedule assignment so an agent can choose valid targets.

name: assign_schedule_to_entity
description: Assign or clear a schedule for a Person, Vehicle, Gate, or Garage Door. Vehicles with a cleared schedule inherit from owner.

entity_id.description: Person/Vehicle UUID or Home Assistant cover entity ID.

entity_name.description: Person display name or door label.

name: verify_schedule_access
description: Verify whether a schedule or scheduled entity allows access at a specific date/time, honoring vehicle owner inheritance and default policy.

entity_id.description: Person/Vehicle UUID or Home Assistant cover entity ID.

entity_name.description: Person display name or door label.

at.description: ISO datetime. If omitted, uses now.

name: query_integration_health
description: Return redacted health/configuration status for configured IACS integrations, access-event processing, and dependency backup storage.

integration.description: Optional integration name, for example access_events, home_assistant, unifi_protect, discord, whatsapp, dvla, llm, dependency_updates, or all.

name: test_integration_connection
description: Run a confirmed integration connection test. This may contact external providers and requires confirm=true.

name: query_system_settings
description: Return redacted dynamic system settings, optionally filtered by category.

name: update_system_settings
description: Update dynamic system settings. Secrets are redacted and the mutation requires confirm=true.

name: query_auth_secret_status
description: Return auth-secret source/readiness status without revealing the secret value.

name: query_alfred_runtime_events
description: Return recent redacted Alfred chat runtime failures, including WebSocket/SSE/HTTP crashes caught by the backend.

name: rotate_auth_secret
description: Rotate the file-backed auth root secret with a generated value. Requires confirm=true and invalidates sessions/action links.

name: query_dependency_updates
description: List tracked system dependencies and available update metadata.

name: check_dependency_updates
description: Check dependency registries for updates. Requires confirm=true.

name: analyze_dependency_update
description: Analyze a dependency update target using release data and configured LLM/heuristics. Requires confirm=true.

name: apply_dependency_update
description: Start an existing dependency apply job. Requires confirm=true and never runs shell commands directly from Alfred.

name: query_dependency_backups
description: List dependency update offline backups, optionally for one dependency.

name: restore_dependency_backup
description: Start an existing dependency backup restore job. Requires confirm=true.

name: query_dependency_update_job
description: Return status for a dependency update apply/restore job.

name: configure_dependency_backup_storage
description: Configure local/NFS/Samba backup storage for dependency updates. Sensitive mount options are accepted but redacted. Requires confirm=true.

name: validate_dependency_backup_storage
description: Validate dependency update backup storage writability/free space. Requires confirm=true.
